content:
OpenSearch Ingestion provides specialized processors that normalize and enrich your trace data
during ingestion, ensuring your telemetry follows consistent patterns and is ready for analysis. Key
processors for trace data include:
Traces
1831
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
• service_map – Automatically builds service dependency graphs from span relationships,
showing how requests ﬂow between services.
• trace_group – Aggregates related spans into logical trace groups based on entry span
attributes like HTTP method and path.
• otel_trace_raw – Processes raw OpenTelemetry trace data and extracts span attributes,
resource attributes, and instrumentation scope information into searchable ﬁelds.
